description_summary: Use when reviewing GitHub PR feedback, applying authorized TypeScript fixes, verifying tests and preparing replies or thread resolution.
should_trigger: Address the unresolved review comments on this GitHub pull request.
Fetch reviewer feedback and prepare fixes for the current PR head.
Review each thread before deciding whether the suggested change is correct.
Draft responses to actionable PR feedback after checking the code.
Resolve the requested PR issues and run the affected checks.
should_trigger_test: Identify outdated review threads that refer to a previous commit.
Keep bot suggestions separate from verified defects in this PR review.
should_not_trigger: Watch this pull request for new review comments and check results.
Review this branch diff for correctness and starter architecture issues.
Audit the pnpm lock dependency graph for supply-chain risks.
Freeze edits to the database package for this investigation.
Walk me through the reasoning behind this existing implementation plan.
